Daytrip City 1026c1 — changes and known issues

New in 1026c1
- Race courses: the agent can set up races on marked courses with laps and checkpoints.
- Boat tours: boats can take residents on ordered tours along the shoreline.
- Chefs now work at the diner and serve there.
- Furnishings the agent places for a wish inside a building stay where they were placed.
- Residents you meet speak lines written by the model, and a saved conversation stays with the residents who were in it.
- Residents keep their bonds and memories when the city is saved and loaded again.
- Districts 8 and 14 have regenerated layouts.
- Anonymous play data: the welcome screen explains what is sent, and a switch in Settings turns it off.

Known issues
- Known issues listed in the 1020v2 notes (releases/1020v2.txt) that are not named above as fixed can still occur.
